verdict.rationale: Ardent is a Postgres branching platform, so a built-in query-insights view is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no such view. The closest item is an 'index validation' workflow (ardent-docs-22), where you test an index on a branch yourself. That is a user-run testing pattern, not a built-in display of slow queries, index recommendations, or performance metrics.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see slow queries, index recommendations, and performance metrics in a built-in insights view
